title: Balance Point
difficulty: Easy
position: 4
complexity: O(n)
=== statement
Find the first position in the array where the sum of the numbers to its left equals the sum of the numbers to its right. The number at that position belongs to neither side, and an empty side adds up to 0.

The sums can be larger than a 32-bit integer.
=== input
The first line has `n`. The second line has the `n` integers.
=== output
Print the first such position (0-based), or `-1` if there is none.
=== constraints
1 <= n <= 131072
-10^6 <= values <= 10^6
=== sample
6
1 7 3 6 5 6
--- expected
3
=== sample
3
1 2 3
--- expected
-1
=== sample
3
2 1 -1
--- expected
0
=== test
1
5
--- expected
0
=== test
2
0 0
--- expected
0
=== test
3
1 2 3
--- expected
-1
=== test
5
-1 3 2 -4 1
--- expected
1
=== test
4
0 0 0 0
--- expected
